selection_basis: Validation accuracy plus promising CUDA Graph scout on already observed true-grid development data. Not final evidence of a win.
runtime: Same frozen FP32 TorchScript CUDA Graph for all three seeds;TF32off;shape determined from actual query count,not tuned after results. Main timing includes pinned CPU VOF/Courant to completed CPU output,including transfers and synchronization;resident separate.

independent_physical_refinement.policy: Preserve all raw predefined queries. Report local curvature and conservative whole-structure resolution masks,per-N coverage and fixed cross-N support;unresolved low-N cases do not support primary claims.

independent_true_grids.policy: Full VOF fields,all actual interface queries,all R/h>=4,no copied samples;fixed scenes across refinements,Courant0.5.

baselines: Actual Aphros production PLIC and actual SimLiquid PLIC on identical raw float32 VOF promoted as required. CPU pinned1/4/8 workers;retain all native timings and compare against fastest tested native,not a deliberately slow configuration.
timing: Warmup10;31 synchronized real repetitions per case,all raw values and quantiles retained;GPU formal only after90s with no foreign compute and with telemetry clean during measurement. Shared measurements are explicitly provisional. Hardware waiting separate from inference cost.
accuracy: Transported-volume MAE without h^2 as primary;retain every seed and output failure. Report physical refinement and radius bins as well as aggregate. No changed weights,architecture,runtime or precision after test results.
curvature: Does not enter final independent test: bounded qMSE and symmetry diagnostics still miss native particles accuracy. Preserve full negative validation results;do not claim solved convergence or beating HF.
stop: This is final frozen evaluation of the promising flux candidate,not a new search. Deliver honest outcomes even if independent data do not confirm development gains.
